import sys, struct, plistlib
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from harness import *
from protocols import adb_packet, get_value_request

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 2)
T1 = '2001:db8:1:1200::1'
T2 = '2001:db8:1:1200::2'
NET = '2001:db8:1:1200::/64'

disc = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
S = {'web': 'tcp'}

# basic assignment
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('plan basic', got['plan'], {'resolved': 1, 'cost': 7, 'assignments': [
    {'request': 'r1', 'offer': 'o1', 'send': [], 'finish': []}]})
ok &= check('active', got['active_requests'], [{'id': 'r1', 'active': True}])

# unknown target -> inactive request
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T2)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('unknown target inactive', got['active_requests'], [{'id': 'r1', 'active': False}])
ok &= check('unknown target no plan', got['plan'], {'resolved': 0, 'cost': 0, 'assignments': []})

# known service state -> inactive
rows = disc + [app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('known service inactive', got['active_requests'], [{'id': 'r1', 'active': False}])

# activity frozen at its own query (later snapshot opens the service)
rows = disc + [app('a', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10, 60], [make_capture(rows)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('frozen activity', got['active_requests'], [{'id': 'r1', 'active': True}])
ok &= check('frozen plan', got['plan']['resolved'], 1)

# service mismatch, prefix mismatch, time window
got, _ = run(campaign([L], {'web': 'tcp', 'ssh': 'tcp'}, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1, 'web')],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'ssh', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('service mismatch', got['plan']['resolved'], 0)
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', '2001:db8:9::/64', 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('prefix mismatch', got['plan']['resolved'], 0)
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 9, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('offer too early', got['plan']['resolved'], 0)
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 100, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('offer at lease end', got['plan']['resolved'], 0)
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 99, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('offer inside lease', got['plan']['resolved'], 1)

# offer capacity
rows = disc + [icmp('j', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i2', T2, T2, 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1), request('r2', 10, 'home', T2)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1', 'r2'])]))
ok &= check('capacity one', (got['plan']['resolved'], got['plan']['cost']), (1, 7))

# request quota tree: root capacity limits both
tree = [{'id': 'root', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 1},
        {'id': 'a', 'parent': 'root', 'capacity': 5},
        {'id': 'b', 'parent': 'root', 'capacity': 5}]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1, 'web', 'a'),
                                request('r2', 10, 'home', T2, 'web', 'b')],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 5, 7, 'q', ['r1', 'r2'])],
                      rq=tree))
ok &= check('request quota root', got['plan']['resolved'], 1)

# offer quota tree
otree = [{'id': 'root', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 1},
         {'id': 'a', 'parent': 'root', 'capacity': 5},
         {'id': 'b', 'parent': 'root', 'capacity': 5}]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1), request('r2', 10, 'home', T2)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 5, 7, 'a', ['r1', 'r2']),
                              offer('o2', 11, 'web', NET, 5, 3, 'b', ['r1', 'r2'])],
                      oq=otree))
ok &= check('offer quota root', (got['plan']['resolved'], got['plan']['cost']), (1, 3))

# capacity zero is meaningful
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 0, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
ok &= check('capacity zero', got['plan']['resolved'], 0)
zero = [{'id': 'q', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 0}]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])],
                      rq=zero))
ok &= check('request quota zero', got['plan']['resolved'], 0)
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])],
                      oq=zero))
ok &= check('offer quota zero', got['plan']['resolved'], 0)

# min cost among max cardinality
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1), request('r2', 10, 'home', T2)],
                      offers=[offer('cheap', 11, 'web', NET, 2, 1, 'q', ['r1', 'r2']),
                              offer('dear', 11, 'web', NET, 2, 100, 'q', ['r1', 'r2'])]))
ok &= check('min cost', (got['plan']['resolved'], got['plan']['cost']), (2, 2))

# adb certificate
A = {'dev': 'adb'}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], A, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1, 'dev')],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'dev', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
send, finish = got['plan']['assignments'][0]['send'], got['plan']['assignments'][0]['finish']
import base64
from protocols import read_adb_response
cn = read_adb_response(base64.b64decode(send[0]))
cl = base64.b64decode(finish[0])
ok &= check('adb cnxn', cn, ('CNXN', 0, 0, 0, 'host::zgrab2'))
ok &= check('adb clse', (cl[:4], cl[4:20], cl[20:]), (b'CLSE', b'\x00'*16, b''))
ok &= check('adb single frames', (len(send), len(finish)), (1, 1))

# sync certificate
Y = {'sync': 'sync'}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], Y, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1, 'sync')],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'sync', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])]))
send, finish = got['plan']['assignments'][0]['send'], got['plan']['assignments'][0]['finish']
raw = [base64.b64decode(x) for x in send]
parsed = []
for blob in raw:
    n = int.from_bytes(blob[:4], 'big')
    parsed.append(plistlib.loads(blob[4:4+n]))
    ok &= check('sync frame length', 4+n, len(blob))
ok &= check('sync dicts', parsed, [
    {'Key': 'ProductVersion', 'Label': 'usbmuxd', 'ProtocolVersion': '2', 'Request': 'GetValue'},
    {'Key': 'ProductName', 'Label': 'usbmuxd', 'ProtocolVersion': '2', 'Request': 'GetValue'}])
ok &= check('sync finish empty', finish, [])

# assignments sorted by request id, duplicates are distinct obligations
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
                      requests=[request('b', 10, 'home', T1), request('a', 10, 'home', T1)],
                      offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 2, 5, 'q', ['a', 'b'])]))
ok &= check('sorted ids', [x['request'] for x in got['plan']['assignments']], ['a', 'b'])
ok &= check('two obligations', (got['plan']['resolved'], got['plan']['cost']), (2, 10))

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
